name: 60548 · Sandwich, IL
findings: ZIP 60548 (Sandwich) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60548 (Sandwich) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60548 (Sandwich) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
